title: mentha gentilis var. pugetii
intro: Mentha gentilis var. pugetii, commonly known as Peppermint, is a natural hybrid of spearmint and watermint. It has been used for its numerous health benefits, including relief from nausea, digestive issues, and headaches due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Peppermint include reducing stress and anxiety, improving respiratory function, and alleviating symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Peppermint include menthol, menthone, limonene, and eucalyptol, which are responsible for its characteristic flavor and aroma, as well as its medicinal properties.
